limitations: This was an iterative development sequence with changing prompts, output protocols and generation profiles, not a controlled success-rate benchmark.
Attempts23,24,27 passed the original frozen fifteen assertions but failed separately recorded preservation checks. Their statuses and denominators remain unchanged.
Attempt29 originally passed the frozen suite; the separately recorded later v2 preservation check expands the exported guard policy without rewriting that original acceptance.

New authored repairs and later revisions require both gates automatically; a synthetic-provider integration test uses real browsers to prove candidate23 is rejected even when all frozen assertions pass.
The model-generated source is not manually corrected. Rejected content remains unexecuted. Read-only parser feedback is bound to its own output digest.
No participant study, maintainer acceptance, independent human accessibility review, locked holdout or matched-agent baseline was performed.
Authored appointments and attendees are fictional. Actual protected outcomes belong to local fresh service sessions.
